mainEntity.name: How does the AI scribe work in a pediatric setting?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Sidekick is ambient. It listens in the background and drafts the note while your therapist stays focused on the child, which pediatric teams value since they often can't take their eyes or hands off a patient. Your team obtains patient or guardian consent before recording.

Pediatric sessions are loud and mobile, and Sidekick is built for that. It filters out the background noise of a busy gym so the clinical conversation comes through, and your therapists record from whatever device they already have with them, whether that's a laptop, tablet, or phone. Documentation follows them around the room instead of tying them to a workstation.

What comes back is a structured draft, not a wall of text. Sidekick maps what it heard into the right sections of your note, so subjective lands in subjective and assessment lands in assessment, and your therapist reviews and edits from there. They can also dictate straight into a specific area of the chart, or combine that with ambient recording in the same session. You can configure pediatric-specific terminology and goal structures so the output matches your clinical voice.

For scenarios like largely non-verbal patients or group and multi-child sessions, it's worth seeing a live example, since results depend on how the session and your custom instructions are set up. We'll walk through it with you.
